verdict.rationale: Dictation is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions system-wide dictation. The nearby items cover different capabilities: Siri AI draft generation and feedback, and customizing Siri's voice expressivity and pace. Neither is speech-to-text input anywhere in the system, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate text anywhere in the system using built-in AI dictation
